about: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells components to automotive original equipment manufacturers in India, Germany, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Wiring Harness, Modules and Polymer Products, Vision Systems, Integrated Assemblies, and Emerging Businesses segments.
